name: Penuel
overview: Penuel, also called Peniel, is notably recognized as the site where Jacob wrestled with the angel, an event marked by his limping as he passed over Penuel at sunrise. This location later became a fortified city built by Jeroboam, as recorded in 1 Kings, and was involved in conflict during the time of Gideon, who threatened and destroyed its tower after the men of Penuel refused to aid him. Additionally, Penuel is identified as the name of a chief of Gedor and a Benjamite, linking the name to both a place and individuals in Israel's history.
